description: Workflow Inspector rule catalog (schema from Workflow_Inspector_Rules_Engine_ChatGPT_2026-11-24.v1.docx section 7).

rules.name: Connector action inside Apply to each
rules.message: A connector action runs once for every item of an Apply to each loop.
rules.risk: Each iteration is a separate API call: slow runs, connector throttling (429) and API quota consumption.
remediation: Filter items server-side first
Use a batch / bulk operation where the connector offers one
Limit the loop to the items that really need the call

rules.name: Nested Apply to each
rules.message: An Apply to each is nested inside another Apply to each.
rules.risk: Work grows as outer x inner items and run time and action counts explode.
remediation: Flatten the data with Select / Filter array / Join before looping
Move the inner loop into a child flow
Use a lookup (Filter array) instead of an inner loop

rules.name: Excessive loop nesting
rules.message: Loops or containers are nested too deeply.
rules.risk: Hard to understand and test; costs multiply per level.
remediation: Split the logic into child flows
Pre-shape the data so one loop suffices
Replace deep Condition nesting with Switch or early Terminate

rules.name: Sequential processing where parallelism is safe
rules.message: An Apply to each is forced to run sequentially although its iterations share no variables.
rules.risk: Unnecessarily long run duration.
remediation: Increase the loop degree of parallelism after confirming iterations are independent

rules.name: Parallel processing against unsafe shared state
rules.message: A concurrent Apply to each writes to a target that does not depend on the current item.
rules.risk: Parallel iterations overwrite each other and results become non-deterministic.
remediation: Make the loop sequential
Write a distinct target per item
Aggregate results after the loop

rules.name: Long Delay action
rules.message: A Delay or Delay until action waits for an hour or longer.
rules.risk: The run stays open (30 day maximum), holds capacity and is exposed to timeouts and edits.
remediation: Use a Recurrence flow that checks a date column
Use an Approval / webhook wait instead of sleeping
Keep delays short

rules.name: Delay inside loop
rules.message: A Delay action runs on every iteration of a loop.
rules.risk: Total wait time = delay x items; runs can exceed the 30 day limit.
remediation: Remove the delay and rely on retry/backoff
Throttle with loop concurrency
Move delayed work to a scheduled flow

rules.name: Long-running Do Until polling loop
rules.message: A Do until loop is allowed to poll for an hour or longer or for 60+ iterations.
rules.risk: Polling burns API calls and holds the run open.
remediation: Lower the count and timeout
Use a trigger or webhook/callback instead of polling
Poll with an increasing delay

rules.name: Get items without server-side Filter Query
rules.message: A list/get-rows action has no filter query, so the whole data source is returned.
rules.risk: Slow runs, hitting row limits and wasted API calls.
remediation: Add a Filter Query / OData $filter
Add Top Count and ordering
Select only the needed columns

rules.name: Large data retrieval followed by Filter array
rules.message: Filter array is used to filter the result of a list/get-rows action.
rules.risk: All rows are transferred then filtered in the flow.
remediation: Move the condition into the connector Filter Query

rules.name: Repeated identical connector query
rules.message: The same connector read is executed more than once with identical parameters.
rules.risk: Duplicate API calls and slower runs.
remediation: Reuse the first result via a variable or Compose

rules.name: Expensive operation repeatedly executed in loop
rules.message: An HTTP call, child flow or connector read runs inside a loop.
rules.risk: Cost scales with the number of items and triggers throttling.
remediation: Fetch once before the loop
Batch requests
Use a single query with a filter

rules.name: Abnormally long median run duration
rules.message: The median run duration is far above the flow's historical baseline.
rules.risk: Slow flows tie up capacity and delay business processes.
remediation: Review recent run history for slow actions

rules.name: Trigger permits unsafe overlapping runs
rules.message: The trigger has no concurrency limit while the flow writes data.
rules.risk: Overlapping runs can corrupt shared data or duplicate work.
remediation: Enable trigger concurrency control and set Degree of Parallelism to 1
Make writes idempotent

rules.name: Concurrency disabled on high-volume trigger
rules.message: Runs are serialized although the flow does not write shared data.
rules.risk: Backlog under load.
remediation: Allow more parallel runs if the flow is safe to overlap

rules.name: Parallel branches modify same resource
rules.message: Parallel branches perform the same kind of write on one connector.
rules.risk: Last-writer-wins corruption and race conditions.
remediation: Chain the actions with run after
Merge the updates into one call

rules.name: Loop concurrency writes shared variable
rules.message: A variable is modified inside a loop that runs iterations in parallel.
rules.risk: Lost updates and non-deterministic variable values.
remediation: Set loop concurrency to 1
Build results with Select / Filter array instead of variables

rules.name: Read-modify-write without concurrency protection
rules.message: An item is read and later updated while runs may overlap.
rules.risk: Concurrent runs overwrite each other's changes.
remediation: Limit trigger concurrency to 1
Use ETag / row-version checks
Update only the columns that change

rules.name: Multiple runs update same SharePoint item
rules.message: Run history shows multiple runs updating the same item.
rules.risk: Conflicting updates and trigger storms.
remediation: Add a trigger condition or processing marker

rules.name: Shared Excel file used as transactional database
rules.message: A concurrent flow or loop writes rows into an Excel workbook.
rules.risk: File locks, failed writes and corrupt tables.
remediation: Use Dataverse, SQL or SharePoint lists
Serialize writes

rules.name: Triggered process has no idempotency check
rules.message: The flow creates records on every trigger event with no duplicate check.
rules.risk: Duplicate trigger events create duplicate records.
remediation: Check whether the record exists before creating
Use trigger conditions
Store a processing marker

rules.name: Retry can create duplicate business record
rules.message: Run history shows retried create actions that produced duplicates.
rules.risk: Duplicate business records.
remediation: Use idempotency keys

rules.name: Flow can retrigger itself through data update
rules.message: The flow is triggered by changes to a data source that it also updates.
rules.risk: The update can start another run and create recursive executions.
remediation: Add a trigger condition
Add an ownership or processing marker
Make the operation idempotent
Avoid updating trigger-sensitive columns when unnecessary

rules.name: Connector connection unhealthy
rules.message: A connection used by the flow is in an error state.
rules.risk: The flow fails on its next run.
remediation: Re-authenticate the connection

rules.name: Flow depends on individual owner's connection
rules.message: A connection belongs to an individual user instead of a service account.
rules.risk: The flow breaks when the user leaves or changes password.
remediation: Use a service principal / service account connection

rules.name: Unexpected connector introduced
rules.message: A connector is used that is not in the approved connector list.
rules.risk: Unvetted data egress paths.
remediation: Use an approved connector
Request approval and add it to the list

rules.name: Connector violates approved connector catalog
rules.message: A blocked connector is used by the flow.
rules.risk: Policy violation and data exfiltration risk.
remediation: Remove the connector or obtain an exception

rules.name: Critical action has no failure path
rules.message: An action that writes data or calls a service has no run-after failure path.
rules.risk: Failures stop the flow silently or leave data half-updated.
remediation: Wrap the actions in a Try scope
Add a Catch scope configured to run after Failed and TimedOut

source.name: Power Automate - employ robust error handling

rules.name: Scope missing Configure run after failure branch
rules.message: A Scope has no sibling that runs after it Failed or TimedOut.
rules.risk: The try/catch pattern is incomplete.
remediation: Add a Catch scope with run after Failed and TimedOut

source.name: Power Automate - employ robust error handling

rules.name: Failure swallowed without logging
rules.message: A failure handler does not notify, log or terminate the run as failed.
rules.risk: Errors disappear and nobody notices.
remediation: Send a notification or write a log record
End the handler with Terminate (Failed)

source.name: Power Automate - employ robust error handling

rules.name: Flow has no terminal error state
rules.message: The flow writes data but never ends a run as Failed or Cancelled on purpose.
rules.risk: Handled errors appear as Succeeded runs, hiding problems from monitoring.
remediation: Add a Terminate (Failed) action at the end of the Catch scope

source.name: Power Automate - employ robust error handling

rules.name: Excessive automatic retries
rules.message: An action is configured with more retries than recommended.
rules.risk: Retries amplify load on a failing service.
remediation: Reduce the retry count
Use exponential backoff

source.name: Handle errors and exceptions in Azure Logic Apps

rules.name: Retry operation is not idempotent
rules.message: A create/POST action keeps the default retry policy.
rules.risk: A timeout followed by a retry can create duplicate records.
remediation: Set retry policy to None for creates
Send an idempotency key
Check for an existing record first

source.name: Handle errors and exceptions in Azure Logic Apps

rules.name: Repeated HTTP 429 responses
rules.message: Run history shows repeated HTTP 429 throttling.
rules.risk: Slow or failing runs.
remediation: Reduce parallelism and calls per run

rules.name: Trigger condition should be used
rules.message: The first action filters on trigger data instead of using a trigger condition.
rules.risk: Runs start (and consume capacity) only to exit immediately.
remediation: Move the test into the trigger's Trigger Conditions setting

rules.name: Trigger causes unnecessary executions
rules.message: The recurrence interval is shorter than recommended.
rules.risk: Frequent polling consumes capacity and API quota.
remediation: Increase the interval
Use an event trigger instead of polling

rules.name: Excessively complex condition expression
rules.message: A condition is long or deeply nested.
rules.risk: Hard to read, easy to get wrong.
remediation: Compute parts in Compose actions
Split into several conditions or a Switch

rules.name: Null/empty value not protected
rules.message: A condition reads a dynamic value without null protection.
rules.risk: The condition action fails when the property is missing.
remediation: Use ?[ ] safe access or coalesce()
Test empty() first

rules.name: Repeated failure threshold exceeded
rules.message: The recent failure rate is above the allowed threshold.
rules.risk: Sustained failures go unnoticed.
remediation: Investigate failing runs and add alerts

rules.name: Run duration increased materially
rules.message: Recent runs are materially slower than before.
rules.risk: Gradual degradation.
remediation: Compare recent and baseline action durations

rules.name: Production flow outside solution
rules.message: A production flow is not part of a solution.
rules.risk: No ALM, no environment promotion, harder ownership transfer.
remediation: Move the flow into a solution

rules.name: Hard-coded environment-specific identifier
rules.message: An environment-specific GUID, site URL or host name is typed into an action.
rules.risk: The flow breaks or touches production when promoted between environments.
remediation: Use environment variables or parameters
Use connection references

rules.name: Hard-coded secret or token
rules.message: A password, key or bearer token is stored in the flow definition.
rules.risk: Anyone who can read or export the flow can steal the credential.
remediation: Move secrets to Azure Key Vault or an environment variable of type Secret
Mark the input as secure
Rotate the exposed credential

rules.name: Expression syntax error
rules.message: An expression has unbalanced parentheses, brackets or quotes or an unexpected token.
rules.risk: The action fails at design time or at run time.
remediation: Fix the expression syntax
Paste it into a Compose action to validate

rules.name: Unknown expression function
rules.message: An expression calls a function that does not exist in the Workflow Definition Language.
rules.risk: The action fails at run time.
remediation: Correct the function name using the WDL functions reference

rules.name: Wrong number of function arguments
rules.message: A function is called with too few or too many arguments.
rules.risk: The expression is invalid and the action fails.
remediation: Check the function signature in the WDL functions reference

rules.name: Reference to missing action or parameter
rules.message: An expression refers to an action or parameter that does not exist.
rules.risk: The expression fails; often caused by renaming or deleting an action.
remediation: Update the reference to an existing action name

rules.name: Reference to action that has not run yet
rules.message: An expression uses the output of an action that is not guaranteed to run before it.
rules.risk: The value is empty or the action fails.
remediation: Reorder the actions or reference an upstream action

rules.name: Null-unsafe property access
rules.message: A property of an action output is read with [ ] instead of the null-safe ?[ ].
rules.risk: The action fails if the property is missing.
remediation: Use ?['name'] and wrap with coalesce() for a default

rules.name: item() / items() outside its loop
rules.message: item() or items('X') is used where no matching Apply to each encloses the action.
rules.risk: The expression fails at run time.
remediation: Move the action into the loop or reference the data another way

rules.name: Variable not initialized before use
rules.message: variables('x') is used without a prior Initialize variable action.
rules.risk: The run fails with an undefined variable error.
remediation: Add Initialize variable at the top level before first use

rules.name: Expression too complex
rules.message: An expression is very long or deeply nested.
rules.risk: Hard to read, review and debug.
remediation: Split into several Compose actions with meaningful names
